summary: This is a routine 8-K filed by American Honda Receivables LLC reporting the filing of a prospectus for a securitization (Honda Auto Receivables 2026-2 Owner Trust) offering five classes of asset-backed notes totaling $2.105 billion. The sponsor retains at least 5% of each class. There is no change of control, merger, tender offer, special distribution, or activist event. This is an ordinary ABS issuance and not a special situation.
